summary: Keep in-memory 1-minute, 5-minute and 1-hour windows of SQL statement, transaction and writer-hold times

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the windows are process memory only.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: No API or protocol change in this part; the windows are not yet shown anywhere.

downtime.detail: Normal restart on deploy; the windows start empty after each restart.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build drops only the in-memory windows.
